main_measure.name: mean 10-bar forward return on short bars minus mean over all bars (non-overlapping blocks)
main_measure.threshold: at most -1.0% per 10 bars with t-stat of -2 or lower to confirm; 0 or above rejects

supporting_check.name: falling share on short blocks minus falling share on all blocks (points)

decided_by: Rejected: the conditional-minus-unconditional difference is 0 or above, or the falling share on short bars is not above the unconditional share.
reading: Blocks are the bars at positions 0,10,20,... of each window with a full 10-bar forward return inside the window, short blocks are those whose bar has forecast < 0, the t-stat is Welch's t between short blocks and all blocks, the main measure is reported in percent, and a downward cross is counted each time the component's raw spread goes from >= 0 to < 0 within a window.
